name: imovies
description: IMovies – full-stack movie ticket booking platform (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix client
